notes: The payload of each state is what gets JSON.serialize'd into OutageStatusCardData.outageJSON. The 'default' state is what OutageStatusCardDemo returns.

states.label: Active outage
states.description: The main case: a confirmed outage with a repair timeline and a restoration ETA.

states.label: No outage
states.description: Nothing wrong at this address. Worth designing deliberately — it is the answer the agent gives most often.

states.label: Error
states.description: The sentinel shape. The service returns this instead of null so the card still mounts and can say what went wrong.

payload.error: Could not reach the network status service. Try again in a moment.
